verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a CLI package manager, and a built-in AI assistant is a capability such a tool could plausibly ship, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack describes any built-in AI assistant or task delegation to an AI. The docs cover only package installation, taps, bottles, Brewfiles and analytics.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
